hints.title: Level Order Traversal
hints.text: A standard breadth-first level order traversal yields node values tier by tier.

hints.title: Sum per Level
hints.text: At each level, compute the sum of values of all nodes on that tier.

hints.title: Minimum Tracking
hints.text: Track the minimum sum and the earliest level where that sum occurs.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import deque
from typing import Optional

class Solution:
    def minimumLevel(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> int:
        if not root:
            return 0
        q = deque([root])
        level = 1
        min_sum = float('inf')
        ans_level = 1
        while q:
            sz = len(q)
            cur_sum = 0
            for _ in range(sz):
                node = q.popleft()
                cur_sum += node.val
                if node.left:
                    q.append(node.left)
                if node.right:
                    q.append(node.right)
            if cur_sum < min_sum:
                min_sum = cur_sum
                ans_level = level
            level += 1
        return ans_level
```

variables: n: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Every node is enqueued and dequeued once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; single BFS traversal is asymptotically optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(w) space stored in the queue.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Write clean queue-based level traversal without off-by-one errors.
